name: Rocky Long's 3-3-5 Stack
description: Three down linemen with all three linebackers stacked directly behind them at identical depth, so no offense can read gap responsibility pre-snap. Five defensive backs play every down against any formation. The call is pressure-by-committee: slant-exchange games move all six box defenders one gap at a time, edge storms fire from both C-gaps, safeties and corners cross-dog through vacated lanes, and empty sets meet an all-out zero with straight man coverage behind.
